jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action  Range: Weapons Range Duration: Special
Components: W (Any Flail), M Cost: 3 Chakra Keywords: Bukijutsu, Chain Description: You lay your weapons striking portion onto the ground leaving it in place. When you cast this jutsu, select a point within your weapons range. All spaces within 10 feet of this space are treated as the Trigger Range. You must remain within 15 feet of this select space, or this jutsu ends with no effect.
As a reaction on another creatures turn you can trigger this jutsu. All creatures within the Trigger Range must make a Dexterity saving throw. If their passive perception is lower than the DC, they make their save at disadvantage.
On a failed save they are Grappled, knocked Prone and pulled up to 10 feet into a space of your choice.
